name: Anima Holding S.A.
summary: Anima Holding S.A. operates as a private higher education organization in Brazil. It has 1,18,000 students enrolled in classroom courses at 16 campuses located in the states of São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Paraná, Goiás, Bahia, and Sergipe. The company was formerly known as GAEC Educação S.A. and changed its name to Anima Holding S.A. in February 2018. Anima Holding S.A. was founded in 2003 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
